items.source: Abstraction over a list of parameter value types. Allows to check whether a list of parameter values with the given type setup is a candidate for the invocation of a given Method (see areValidFor(Method)). This is necessary to properly match parameter values against methods declaring varargs arguments. The implementation favors direct matches and only computes the alternative sets of types to be considered if the primary one doesn't match.
items.translation: 对参数值类型列表的抽象。允许检查具有给定类型设置的参数值列表是否为调用某个 Method 的候选项（参见 areValidFor(Method)）。这是为了正确匹配参数值与声明可变参数参数的方法所必需的。实现优先采用直接匹配，仅当主要匹配失败时才计算需要考虑的替代类型集。

items.source: Returns whether the parameter types are valid for the given Method.

items.translation: 返回给定Method的参数类型是否有效。这意味着，具有给定类型排列的参数值列表是调用该方法的合法列表。
